newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas actively traded, winter rises again.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas actively traded, winter rises again.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures bounced back to life on Tuesday morning as 325 lots were traded at mixed prices.

The winter continued its recent rise as January and February traded 100 lots each in four separate deals. January last traded at 18.40 pence a therm, up 0.16 pence, while February last traded up 0.15 pence at 18.425 pence.
At the close Q1 was bid at 16.87 pence and offered at 17.03 pence. By comparison Q1 traded at 16.95 pence a therm on the OTC market on Monday evening.
October, December and June all fell, while May and July were up as well as January and February. A total of 13 trades was done.

Bids and offers were posted in all 12 contract months at the close. The spread on front month August, which rolls later in the day, was 9.25/9.475 pence. The high volume of trade follows a blank day on Monday with nothing done at all.
